metadata.disclaimer: This benchmark is a synthetic evaluation fixture constructed specifically to evaluate root cause identification, evidence retrieval, claim grounding, and uncertainty abstention. Results on this benchmark are distinct from real-world benchmarks (such as HDFS LogBERT) and do not claim statistical generalization beyond the tested scenarios.

scenarios.name: Single Service Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
scenarios.description: PostgreSQL database connection pool hits hard maximum capacity, refusing subsequent client connections along an active distributed trace.
alternative_hypotheses: network switch packet loss between gateway and database
